name: int-out-of-range
spec: 3.5.1 Int result coercion: out of range is a field error

errors.message: Can't serialize value (/big) : Expected a value that can be converted to type 'Int' but it was a 'Long'

graphqlJava: graphql-java 26.1 leaves locations off result coercion errors; the spec says an error that can be associated with a point in the document should have them (7.1.6), so the expected error has them
